text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The holy night.
Around the time when everyone had fallen fast asleep—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Quietly, very quietly...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *snooze*...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're sound asleep. Let's see,
as for the present for Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaay, what'cha watchin', Palmer!
Golf?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, gloves. I was thinking I'd like some new ones soon~.
They just released new models, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That said, I'm broke right now,
so I'm just window shopping. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ta-da,
golf gloves!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your cheerful personality is always a great help, Palmer.
...I hope they like it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now then, next up is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mnh-mnh...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nice, fast asleep.
And the present for such a good child is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear,
what's the matter, Fukukitaru!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-saaan~! I-I-I,
I lost my precious good luck charm~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, calm down. It's okay, we'll find it.
Do you remember roughly where you might have dropped it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, *sniff*. U-Uhm...!
I think I was supposed to take it to the grounds and—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The lucky charm you lost! 
Fufu, finding it was quite a workout, I must say. Our grounds are awfully vast, after all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm glad I found it.
May that brilliant smile return to your face once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, with a secret surprise,
the holy night slowly drew to a close...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, handed out everyone's share properly.
Hehe, I can't wait to see everyone's faces tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...*achoo*.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, it sure is getting chilly.
I'd better head to bed soon too."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Oh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing something, Fuji Kiseki suddenly looks up
at the sky. Following her gaze, there is—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...A shooting star on Christmas.
What a delightfully tasteful present.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Since I'm here, I'll make one wish.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —May the greatest happiness visit those girls again and again, now and forever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Christmas morning.
The lively, cheerful voices of horse girls could be heard
coming from the Ritto Dormitory.
